mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET USER_PASSWORD = #{userPassword}, USER_NICKNAME = #{userNickname}, USER_ADDRESS = #{userAddress}, USER_COUNTRY = #{userCountry}, USER_TEL = #{userTel}, USER_LAST_NAME_EN = #{userLastNameEn}, USER_FIRST_NAME_EN = #{userFirstNameEn}, USER_LAST_NAME_JP = #{userLastNameJp}, USER_FIRST_NAME_JP = #{userFirstNameJp} WHERE USER_MAIL = #{userMail}
